delivery.scope: Runnable code, actual configurations, figures, summaries, test records and reports; not a full raw-evidence independent verification package.

numerical_details.selection_path_policy: A prefers data_A_long same-variant/gap case with >=480 complete turns, then data_A with >=480; otherwise selected pilot is retained and marked pending. B and refinement paths are explicit.
numerical_details.scope: Offline aggregation only; no simulation, native trajectory loading, or source analysis edits.

acceptance_criteria.N3_inner_control_candidate_evidence: Reported from the independent T08 local branch sweep; it is not a per-RHS trajectory gate.
acceptance_criteria.epsilon_definition: For N3 cases, epsilon_num is the maximum absolute independent difference across output sampling, h/2, root tolerance/10, and N1024. For old B0 cases, the comparison set is output sampling, h/2, and N1024 because local root tolerance is not applicable. Each is an engineering error estimate, not a statistical confidence interval.
acceptance_criteria.epsilon_num_definition: epsilon_num contains only measured independent differences; convergence acceptance tolerances are not inserted into it.
acceptance_criteria.significance_epsilon_floor_source: Inherited predeclared V8 precision baseline: config/clearance_v8_config.json health_result.epsilon_E_um=0.0001 um, retained in GPTOrder/spindle_v9_tai_bearing_plan/baseline_snapshot/parameters_v8_calibrated.json.
acceptance_criteria.significance_definition: Primary S_E=abs(E_N3-E_B0)/(epsilon_num_N3+epsilon_num_B0+0.0001 um); report only when same-U comparison and both complete independent error budgets are available. S_E>5 means the difference exceeds this numerical error estimate. Optional conservative sensitivity uses an additional 0.01 um absolute floor.
acceptance_criteria.H_velocity_epsilon_floor_source: Inherited V8 engineering floor: config/clearance_v8_config.json numerical_thresholds.velocity_mm_s=1e-4 mm/s; utils/clearance_v6_analysis.py error_budget uses clearance_v5_analysis.absolute_floor for non-position metrics.
acceptance_criteria.H_velocity_epsilon_floor_interpretation: Engineering error floor only; not a statistical confidence interval or measured detectability.
acceptance_criteria.H_velocity_epsilon_definition: For each of the six H_v RMS, 1X and residual metrics, epsilon_num is the maximum actual same-window absolute difference across output sampling and the selected independent refinements. The floor and V9 convergence tolerances are excluded from epsilon_num.

single_bearing_tests.scope: independent bearing algebra/local sensitivity plus 12-DOF force assembly and short integration; excludes long experiment matrix and machine validation

source_revision.scope: Local-only numerical solver audit; no spindle trajectory.

saved_boundary_samples.note: Local sampling only. Deterministic reseeding does not alter the inconsistent F07/F10 limiting closures or claim general boundary continuity.

source_revision.note: Deterministic retry after the original Newton path fails; only that failure path changes. The unchanged-root and sampled-boundary regression records remain attached.

single_bearing_tests.note: This status covers the original local test suite only. T06 contact-loss boundary continuity is reported separately; counts do not mean every T01–T12 requirement is complete.

overall_single_bearing_capability.note: The completed original 281 local/system checks are reported separately from T06 contact-loss boundary continuity. The 281 checks do not mean the full bearing capability passed.

local_control_branch_audit.scope: Independent local candidate-control and cage-phase sweep; this evidence is not re-solved at each long-trajectory RHS state.
local_control_branch_audit.note: Production N3 outer-control and phase-speed gates remain separate per-case checks; alternate inner candidates are supported by this local sweep and are not a required per-RHS trajectory artifact.

system_integration_tests.scope: 12-DOF static equilibrium, force assembly and two-turn backend replay; no long experiment matrix
system_integration_tests.note: Previously completed static and short-trajectory integration checks; does not cover the long experiment matrix or contact-loss continuity.

contact_boundary.scope: Local boundary audit only; no new spindle trajectory and no change to production physics or parameters.

summary.verdict: The already-detached F10 branch can pass algebra tests; the general finite-speed transition-continuity requirement does not pass. Always-dual trajectories require separate domain assessment.

contact_boundary.note: A failure here blocks generic contact-loss capability; it does not invalidate a separately passing dual-contact N3 trajectory.

contact_loss_boundary.scope: Local boundary audit only; no new spindle trajectory and no change to production physics or parameters.

summary.verdict: The already-detached F10 branch can pass algebra tests; the general finite-speed transition-continuity requirement does not pass. Always-dual trajectories require separate domain assessment.

contact_loss_boundary.note: A failure here blocks generic contact-loss capability; it does not invalidate a separately passing dual-contact N3 trajectory.

convergence_acceptance.note: Independent output-sampling, h/2, root-tolerance/10, and N1024 comparisons are required for a complete E_dir error budget; absent comparisons remain pending.

old_B0_convergence_acceptance.note: Old V8 B0 error budgets require same-window sampling, h/2, and N1024 evidence. A local root-tolerance comparison is not applicable; missing full 480-turn refinements remain pending.

generic_contact_loss_capability.note: This independent generic capability status does not gate numerical acceptance of a selected N3 run that remains in dual contact.

initial_state_provenance.comparison_note: A saved initial state changes the branch start; all final-window metrics are compared as steady statistics.

initial_state_sensitivity.time_window_explanation: Different absolute integration intervals are not aligned samples and are not treated as a numerical refinement. The same-window flag is retained only as a diagnostic; summary statistics are compared under existing V9 metric tolerances after both 480-turn windows pass stationarity.

initial_state_provenance.comparison_note: A saved initial state changes the branch start; all final-window metrics are compared as steady statistics.

initial_state_sensitivity.time_window_explanation: Different absolute integration intervals are not aligned samples and are not treated as a numerical refinement. The same-window flag is retained only as a diagnostic; summary statistics are compared under existing V9 metric tolerances after both 480-turn windows pass stationarity.

same_U_old_new_significance.epsilon_floor_source: Inherited predeclared V8 precision floor: config/clearance_v8_config.json health_result.epsilon_E_um=0.0001 um; same value is retained in GPTOrder/spindle_v9_tai_bearing_plan/baseline_snapshot/parameters_v8_calibrated.json. same_U_old_new_significance.epsilon_num_definition: Each epsilon_num is only the maximum measured independent E_dir difference for that case; no acceptance threshold is inserted into epsilon_num.
